encoding_specification.categorical: one-hot in the declared category order; class IDs are not ordinal
encoding_specification.missing_required_feature: reject offline training row; do not impute from outcome
encoding_specification.constant_features: retain schema slots; assess only on training partition before choosing a versioned transform

deferred_features.state.network.packet_size_estimate: Currently null; actual post-action payload bytes must not fill this field
deferred_features.state.network.estimated_bandwidth: Currently null; units and estimator must be specified before use
deferred_features.raw_trace.rssi_dbm: Sidecar only; requires a versioned correlated projection
deferred_features.raw_trace.psram_free: Sidecar only; requires a versioned correlated projection
deferred_features.energy_budget: No measured battery state; any future budget is estimated/simulated

reward.formula: w_accuracy * correct_success - w_latency * latency_ms/L_ref - w_communication * payload_bytes/B_ref - w_energy_proxy * estimated_energy_proxy/E_ref
reward.missing_component: reward unavailable; no implicit zero or fabricated estimate
reward.storage: Future derived versioned target artifact; never overwrite v1 placeholder reward.final_reward

supervision.logged_action_meaning: executed fixed baseline action, not optimal action
supervision.future_target: argmax expected configured reward among feasible actions under matched pre-decision conditions
supervision.counterfactuals: Not inferred from different states or absent observations
supervision.ties: Record ties/uncertainty; do not invent a unique winner
supervision.preferred_holdout: Independent acquisition sessions/participants; group all action repeats of a window
